description: The AI output is supported by evidence and contains no unsupported claims.
safe_action: Allow standard human review because the output is fully grounded, low risk and supported by sufficient evidence.

description: The AI output is partly supported but includes one unsupported claim.
safe_action: Require reviewer notes before approval because the output is only partially grounded and includes an unsupported claim.

description: The AI output has weak grounding and multiple unsupported claims.
safe_action: Route to senior review because weak grounding and high hallucination risk make standard approval unsafe.

description: The AI output cites a source that was not provided.
safe_action: Block approval because the output fabricates a source and introduces unsupported claims that cannot be used safely.

scenario: Regulated context with medium hallucination risk
description: The AI output concerns a regulated context and should be escalated despite medium hallucination risk.
safe_action: Escalate to senior review because regulated or sensitive contexts require stronger controls even when hallucination risk is medium.

description: The AI output has no supporting evidence and should not be routed to standard review.
safe_action: Escalate to senior review because the output has no supporting evidence and contains unsupported claims.

scenario: Low hallucination risk but incomplete evidence
description: The AI output has low hallucination risk but the evidence base is too thin for automatic approval.
safe_action: Require reviewer notes because the evidence base is limited even though hallucination risk is low.
